name: What is the typical square footage for multi-family units built by Opus Builders?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical square footage for multi-family units built by Opus Builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical square footage for multi-family units built by Opus Builders varies widely depending on the project type and target demographic. For apartment or condominium complexes, units can range from compact studios starting around 450-600 sq ft, to one-bedroom units at 700-900 sq ft, and larger two or three-bedroom units exceeding 1,200 sq ft. We design each project to optimize space and functionality according to client specifications and market needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical square footage for multi-family units varies, from compact studios (450-600 sq ft) to larger two or three-bedroom units (over 1,200 sq ft), tailored to project and market needs.
